verdictDetail: Re-verification of the corrected frozen candidate 573d65a: the independent model (rebuilding all four scenarios from the curated inputs, with refunds settled in cash and the channel-adjusted distributor trade price) reproduces every committed column, the 12/36/60 views and all 24 stress cases with 0 mismatches; the 60-period accounting identities hold; the COST-16 tooling invariant and the MC-12 inherited costs are intact; A-27/A-28/S-12/D-11 catch the corrected defects when re-mutated; the builder is current, the validator reports 77 checks and the adversarial suite is 29/29. The 16 first-audit findings are closed except three non-blocking items kept OPEN with explicit reasons (F-05 contract A-15 formula/check-id mapping still not fully synchronised; F-11 the per-unit metric is a static base-case average and one D13 statement contradicts the data; F-14 CI does not run the financial gate). PASS_INTERNAL_FINANCIAL_SCOPE is awarded for the internal financial scope only; no price, commercial availability, financing approval, break-even verification or MC-14 execution is implied. finalRecordCommit stays null until the Lead records this re-issued audit in the record commit and updates the manifest status block, D20 and the registry row to the awarded verdict.

independentRecomputation.description: Auditor-written model under %TEMP%\mc13-audit (not committed, importing no MC-13 code) rebuilt all scenarios from docs/marea/financial/data/{assumptions,revenue-drivers,recurring-revenue,operating-costs,capital-investments,working-capital,scenario-definitions}.json with the corrected refunds-cash and channel-adjusted distributor rules. It compared 61 numeric column series x 60 periods, the 12/36/60 views, all 24 stress cases, the 70 break-even thresholds and the COST-16/MC-12 inheritance against the committed derived files. A second pass verified the accounting identities directly on the committed columns and reconciled 197 numeric claims from the human-readable documents.
independentRecomputation.periods: 60 periods per scenario; 4 scenarios; 61 column series per hypothetical scenario; 12/36/60 views.

RESTRICTED_CURRENT.note: 60 periods; authorized revenue, output VAT and strictly zero-revenue derivatives evidenced as 0; cost/cash/financing columns null with suppression reason.

identitiesVerified: refundsCash = refundsAllowance in every month of every hypothetical scenario (A-27)
distributorInvoicedGross = units x price x distributorShare x (1 - 35% margin) in every month (max deviation 0.02 EUR; A-28)
cogsHardware = sum(units by SKU x declared unit cost); inventory unit identity exact and never negative; purchases cash = receipts cost + delta(prepayments) - delta(payables)
vatPaid recomputed with one-month lag, recoverable input VAT and credit carry-forward
operatingCashFlow = ebitdaLikeConditional - workingCapitalMovement and equals cashReceiptsGross - vatPaid - software - paymentFees - carrying - fixedOpex - purchasesCash
netCashFlow = operatingCashFlow + investingCashFlow; investingCashFlow = -capexCash; 0 + sum(netCashFlow) = cumulativeCashBalance
financingRequirement = running max(max(0, -cumulativeCashBalance)); deferred-revenue identity; 12/36/60 view totals

residualRisks: External commercial evidence is BLOCKED_OR_NOT_OBTAINED by design: 0 formal supplier quotations, 0 executed contracts, 0 granted licensing rights, 0 customer evidence, CUSTOMER_WTP_VALIDATED = false. Every revenue, contribution, cash and break-even figure is a conditional output of labelled scenario assumptions, not a forecast.

Named unknown costs are excluded from the conditional result: data licence, product-liability insurance, CRA/security lifecycle, FLEET onboarding/DPA/SLA, CAC, validated churn/renewal, willingness to pay and the company cash/funding position. The true financing requirement is higher than every figure reported.
Opening cash is zero by analysis convention (ASM-MC13-044); the real EMBARCARTE cash position is UNKNOWN.

VAT is an illustration (21% Spain, 100% recoverable input VAT on inventory receipts only, one-month lag); the M60 VAT balance is paid in M61 outside the horizon and no tax adviser has confirmed the treatment.
Demand, churn, renewal, activation, channel mix and operating-cost envelopes are illustrative scenario assumptions with no probability; no validated demand exists.

The 60-month horizon truncates collections: with a 2-period distributor lag the last two months of distributor invoices are not collected within the horizon (15,068.64 EUR of BASE receivables at M60).
FX exposure is inherited as an engineering assumption (MC-11 basis) and no hedge exists; the gap is disclosed, not closed (D-053).

Break-even thresholds are CONDITIONAL_HYPOTHETICAL_THRESHOLD or NOT_DETERMINABLE; 0 are VERIFIED. No document may promote them to a verified break-even, profitability, investment-return or launch statement.
Refunds are modelled as paid in the sale month (no lag), equal to the allowance (A-27); a real return lag or a different measured return rate would move the financing requirement.
The corrected distributor/trade-price model conserves total cash over the horizon but still depends on the declared 60-day distributor term and 35% margin, which are scenario assumptions.
The per-unit contribution metric is still a static base-case average (F-11) and the contract check-id mapping/A-15 formula still needs a documentation fix (F-05).
CI does not run the financial gate (F-14); the PR check does not evidence the 77-check run.
